findings.title: Unguarded state-mutating route: POST /webhooks/stripe
findings.description: Route POST /webhooks/stripe in src/api/webhooks.ts performs state mutations via async operations but has no authentication middleware in its handler chain.

findings.title: Signature verification helper "verifyWebhookSignature" exists but is not used by webhooks.ts
findings.description: src/security/auth.ts exports "verifyWebhookSignature" but src/api/webhooks.ts does not import it. Webhook routes should verify HMAC signatures before processing payloads.

findings.title: Port mismatch: documentation says 3000, code uses 8080
findings.description: README.md claims the service runs on port 3000, but the source code binds to port 8080. This will confuse developers and break deployment scripts.

findings.title: Port mismatch: .env.example says 3000, code defaults to 8080
findings.description: .env.example sets PORT=3000, but the code defaults to port 8080. Developers using the example env will connect to the wrong port.

findings.title: Authentication scheme drift: Documentation specifies HMAC, code implements RS256/RSA
findings.description: README.md specifies HMAC authentication as the required authentication scheme, but src/security/auth.ts implements RS256/RSA public-key authentication.

findings.title: Documentation requires HMAC auth for webhooks, but code does not verify signatures
findings.description: README.md states that HMAC authentication is required for webhook endpoints, but src/api/webhooks.ts processes webhook payloads without any signature verification.

counterexamples.description: A POST request to /webhooks/stripe without any authentication credentials reaches the handler and triggers state mutations. No auth middleware intercepts the unauthenticated request.
Documentation and code declare different service ports. A developer following the README will attempt to connect to the wrong port.
A webhook request with an invalid or missing HMAC-SHA256 signature reaches the processing handler. The payload is accepted and triggers database writes without any signature verification.
An authentication/verification helper function exists in the codebase but is not imported or called by security-sensitive route handlers.
